questionText: If a product is sold for ₹720 after a 10% discount, what was its original price?
solutionText: If original price is x, then 90% of x = 720. So x = 720 / 0.9 = ₹800.

questionText: A dealer sells an article by allowing a 13% discount on its marked price and gains 20%. If the cost price of the article is increased by 10%, what discount percentage should he allow now on the same marked price, so as to earn the same percentage of profit as before?
